title: Anthropic launches a repeatable routines feature for Claude Code as a research preview, allowing developers to schedule and automate software development tasks (Zac Hall/9to5Mac)
summary: Zac Hall / 9to5Mac: Anthropic launches a repeatable routines feature for Claude Code as a research preview, allowing developers to schedule and automate software development tasks — Anthropic's Claude Code has a new repeatable routines feature that works even when your Mac is offline.
